thesis: The podcast introduces a miniseries exploring the venture capital industry, specifically focusing on institutional investors who are still investable in the marketplace sector. The host discusses his guest, Fabrice Grinda, founder of FJ Labs, noting that the firm employs heuristics for quick decisions and takes a founder-friendly, non-institutional approach.
